snippet.title: LOADPATH | Gameplay Trailer | Free Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
LOADPATH is a first-person physics demolition game. Find the blocks carrying the load, cut them, and bring the tower down. Spend the salvage on a bigger rig, from twin heads and drones to a laser, a mortar and a wrecking ball, and work your way down through seven industrial sites. Then go as deep as you dare in Endless, with thirty mutators to switch on.

Free demo on Steam now, full game out 12 November 2026:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5291620/Loadpath/

#indiegame #physicsgame #demolition
